children.value: > Fact From Story: Epic claims that Google is illegally tying its Google Play payments platform to the Google Play app store, keeping other potential app payment mechanisms from competing as well.

> > Fact From Story: Epic argues that Google makes it so difficult for developers and users to get around its Android app store, and that app store’s standard fees, that it’s created an illegal monopoly that unjustly enriches Google while artificially driving up app prices because other stores can’t compete.

> > > Fact From Story: Epic also claims that Google is illegally tying its Google Play payments platform to the Google Play app store, keeping other potential app payment mechanisms from competing as well.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Companies create monopolies to unjustly enrich themselves.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Tying two products together makes it difficult for competitors to offer one of the products.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Artificially driving up prices and preventing competition are characteristics of a monopoly.
